system.description: A length of rope from an ossuary bell of the Silent Fraternity, braided from the hair of novices who died at their vigil. Once per day, as ↻ when an ally within 30' would gain a wound, you gain it instead (test Toughness as normal). Expendable d20.
system.lastRite: ◈◈ Pull it until it snaps: every ally within 30' at Death's Door wakes at d4 HP. You gain one wound for each of them (test Toughness as normal).
system.drawback: Harkin keeps count. The next time you would gain a wound, you gain two.
system.faction: the Silent Fraternity of the Cairn
